issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Animal.name as type String, but the reference solution implements the attribute using StringBuilder (private StringBuilder name). This divergence in the attribute type can confuse students about the expected field type and the required getter/setter implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute types consistent. Preferably change the solution's Animal class to use a String for the name (private String name) and update the constructor/getter/setter accordingly so it matches the UML and problem description. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly allow StringBuilder if that choice is intentional.
